entries.title: Formats home
entries.text:
# Formats home

Start with [the install guide](guide.html), then
[install the SDK](guide.html#install-the-sdk).

Read [the concept](topic.dita) and its
[GUID section](topic.dita#GUID-A1B2-C3D4).

The [release notes](notes.adoc) and their
[upgrade steps](notes.adoc#_upgrade) cover what changed.

The [reference](ref.rst) explains the [options](ref.rst#install-ref).
